Based on the context provided, specifically the passage from "NASA Glenn Research Center photos on Flickr" which states, "in 1979, and the shuttle wasn't completed until October 1983 in Palmdale, Calif," and the passage from "Air Force Plant 16" which mentions "final assembly is at Palmdale," the facility is **Palmdale Air Force Base** (also referred to as Rockwell Palmdale facility in the text). The text notes that the Space Division's Orbiter assembly facility was set in place permanently at Pad 39A (at KSC) but the initial construction and assembly of the orbiters, including Discovery (OV-103), took place at the Downey facility initially, with final assembly and closeout occurring at the **Palmdale** facility (Rockwell). The specific military facility in Palmdale associated with this work is Palmdale Air Force Base.

<answer>Palmdale Air Force Base</answer>
